items.title: Verstappen wins in Las Vegas as Norris and Piastri complete the podium
items.summary: Max Verstappen won the 50-lap Las Vegas Grand Prix in 1:27:39.624, 0.639 seconds ahead of Lando Norris; Oscar Piastri was third, 1.529 seconds back. The official classification records the completed result.
items.why_it_matters: Use the final classification, not a pre-race prediction, as the weekend baseline; McLaren placed both drivers on the podium while Verstappen took the win.

items.title: Leclerc and Hamilton say Ferrari must resolve their latest on-track clash
items.summary: After the Turn 7 collision, Leclerc accepted responsibility; the final classification put him P10 and Hamilton P7. Formula1.com's reports differ on whether it was Lap 37 or Lap 38, so no lap number is given. At Qatar media day on 26 November the drivers said they were working toward a solution; Hamilton said they remain free to race and discussions about process belong over winter. No new rule was announced.
items.why_it_matters: Preserve the published lap-number discrepancy rather than choosing one account. Separate Leclerc's final-result penalty from Hamilton's served penalty, and report ongoing discussions as such—not as a new Ferrari rule.

items.title: Lindblad reflects on his Vegas spin and targets Racing Bulls’ P5 fight
items.summary: Arvid Lindblad said he was emotional after spinning out while running near the front in Las Vegas. He is focused on the final two rounds and hopes to help Racing Bulls secure fifth in the Teams’ Championship; the report gives no technical cause for the spin.
items.why_it_matters: His personal account and stated team goal are current post-race context; do not turn the report into an unsupported car-failure explanation.
